notes.title: Steering Wheels
notes.content:
Two new working Steering Wheel props were just added:
[previewyoutube=KORzAmnF3Sc;full][/previewyoutube]

Wheels can be used in empty scenes to create simple steering wheel animations. Or users can create a custom vehicle/car interior reference mesh scenes, and it's simple to add a steering wheel aligned quickly.

Wheels can be scaled up in size, for the helm of a large ship! Simply hover the vr laser on the wheel prop to reveal the prop menu and click the "+" button, scale the wheel to ship scale! Or for any purpose!

Some other creative ideas:
[list]
[*] as a bank vault door bolt locking wheel.
[*] a water valve open/close animation.
[*] controls on a steam locomotive or submarine.
[*] the crank for a rope hoist pulley system.
[*] industrial machines - eg. handles on a manual mill/lathe.
[*] or as DJ turntables.
[/list]

Wheel animations are exporting with the scenes and avatars when exported to Blender. Steering wheel props can be placed anywhere in the scene, Wheels can be grabbed using either single or dual controllers. The wheel rotates with the controller(s), while the avatar's hands remain attached to the steering wheel mesh.

This feature is still beta! Please give the YT video a like!
